topic: A railway station clock stays stuck at 2:13, and one train still arrives at exactly that time.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Train at 2:13

shots.narration: That clock was broken, but its train was never late.
shots.scene: Old Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, brass lantern between two stools, vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look, no writing.
shots.action: Bashir holds a round pocket watch toward Saad, its unnumbered hands showing 2:13.
shots.mood: Amber lantern glow against deep blue fog, long still shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir Chacha told Saad about his first railway night watch.
shots.scene: Same haveli courtyard, weathered arches behind the seated pair, brass lantern glowing between them.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the distant railway beyond the courtyard arch.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, moonlit mist beyond warm shelter.

shots.narration: [whispers] The station clock had stopped at thirteen minutes past two.
shots.scene: Deserted fictional Pakistani railway station, cracked plaster canopy, large unnumbered analog clock with hands showing 2:13, no signage.
shots.action: A loose roof chain sways beneath the motionless clock.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, empty platform, heavy pools of shadow.

shots.narration: Every other clock worked, including the watch in his pocket.
shots.scene: Beneath the station clock, Bashir in his brown shawl and white cap, lantern beside a wooden bench.
shots.action: Bashir opens his unnumbered pocket watch, revealing a moving second hand.
shots.mood: Brass highlights, concentrated lantern light, darkness pressing close.

shots.narration: Then his watch reached the same time.
shots.scene: Close view of Bashir's open pocket watch above the deserted platform, unnumbered face approaching 2:13.
shots.action: The watch's minute hand advances to thirteen minutes past two.
shots.mood: Precise metallic glints, tense stillness, blurred railway darkness.

shots.narration: [surprised] A headlight appeared, but the rails stayed completely silent.
shots.scene: Empty railway tracks vanishing into dense fog beside Bashir's platform, no signs or markings.
shots.action: A single train headlight emerges through the distant fog.
shots.mood: Pale light piercing blue mist, unnaturally undisturbed surroundings.

shots.narration: The train stopped beside him without disturbing a single leaf.
shots.scene: Old unmarked passenger train beside the station platform, dry leaves around Bashir's shoes, lantern in his hand.
shots.action: The train glides to a stop beside Bashir.
shots.mood: Black windows, motionless leaves, soft moonlight on dull metal.

shots.narration: Every window was dark, except the one beside his lantern.
shots.scene: Train carriage beside Bashir, rows of black windows, one window glowing faintly amber.
shots.action: Bashir raises his brass lantern toward the glowing window.
shots.mood: Isolated amber rectangle surrounded by deep, featureless darkness.

shots.narration: [whispers] Inside, he saw the courtyard where Saad now sat.
shots.scene: Bashir outside a train window; through the glass lies the present haveli courtyard, with Saad seated beside the familiar lantern.
shots.action: Saad turns toward the train window from inside the impossible courtyard.
shots.mood: Warm familiar courtyard framed by cold railway metal, unsettling clarity.

shots.narration: Then the carriage handle began turning toward him.
shots.scene: Closed train carriage door beside Bashir, old metal handle sharply lit by his lantern.
shots.action: The carriage handle rotates by itself.
shots.mood: Tight shadows, trembling amber reflections, black gaps around the door.

shots.narration: The door opened, and Saad was sitting on the other side.
shots.scene: Railway platform outside an open carriage doorway; directly beyond the threshold is the haveli courtyard with Saad seated under its arches.
shots.action: The carriage door swings open onto Saad's courtyard.
shots.mood: Impossible doorway, stark moonlight, enormous door shadow falling across Saad.

shots.narration: [whispers] Saad asked, 'Why is there a tunnel behind you now?'
shots.scene: Present haveli courtyard, Bashir opposite Saad beside the lantern; behind Bashir, the familiar arch now contains railway tracks entering a black tunnel.
shots.action: Saad points his small torch into the tunnel behind Bashir.
shots.mood: Warm lantern foreground, bottomless tunnel darkness, faint distant train light.

episode.endHook: Where does the train go when the next station is a tunnel?
episode.description: By his lantern, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a deserted Pakistani railway station where the clock never moves. One train still arrives at 2:13—and its door opens somewhere impossible. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
